column2: You're starting with $10.000 in cash. Your goal? Grow your net worth by buying and selling stocks at the right time.
Browse 15 real stocks with live-updating prices. Watch for green (rising) and red (falling) indicators to spot opportunities.
Tap any stock to buy shares. Go to your Portfolio tab to sell. Prices change every second — timing matters!
Random events like scandals, breakthroughs, and lawsuits will shake the market. Watch for pop-up alerts and react fast!
View interactive price charts, detailed statistics, win rates, and your complete trade history. Knowledge is power!
Adjust the difficulty slider in Settings to control how wild the market gets. Higher difficulty = more events & bigger swings!
